note: JobLease_MC2 shape: two independent jobs under one clock. Activate(j1,w1); Complete(j1) (j1 is now Done and holds no lock); Activate(j2,w1) — the same worker leases a different job; Expire at now=1000 reclaims only j2's lock (j1 is Done, DoneIsTerminal — a completed job is never re-expired or redelivered); Activate(j2,w2) redelivers j2; Complete(j2).
